principles: 学校主体只在唯一home city参加城市主榜；异地校区、研究院、研究生院不抢城市主榜
县区层以实际办学地点为准；只有在没有校区候选时，才采用县区归属依据候选
本科候选优先，地区没有本科候选时专科/高职兜底（项目层次政策，不是排名证据）
同一 comparisonGroup 内的官方名次可以比较；不同榜单体系的名次不互相比较，也不用内部旧名次或中文名排序替代
开放区间（500+ / 100+ / 80+ / 20+）不当作精确名次，区间之间以及区间与落入该区间的名次之间都不排序
无法比较的行政单元保持 unresolved_incomparable，不产生赢家，也不回退到名称排序
外部榜单缺失表示未覆盖，不表示零分或最差
自定义综合分必须保留版本、权重、覆盖率和原始分项

mapWinner.comparison: src/winner-core.js owns this decision; the page and the coverage audit both call it and tests/best-university-parity.mjs asserts they agree

basisOrder.rule: one comparison group, and its champion is unbeaten: an open band only loses to an exact position that lies outside the interval
本科 > 专科 > 成人
985 > 211 > 双一流, an official state designation
district candidates with an actual campus outrank association-only candidates
public before private at equal level and prestige; must be shown as project policy, never as ranking evidence
the unit has exactly one candidate under this definition

mapWinner.legacyFallback: none. universities.rank is the 0-based index of the old mixed 总榜 page, not a published rank: it is neither a winner nor an ordering key. rankLabel survives only as a display hint on a school that no official list covers, and such a school is reported as needing ranking backfill.
mapWinner.nameOrdering: Chinese-name order is used only to keep a candidate list and the generated reports deterministic. It is never used to choose a best university.

atlasComposite.missingDataRule: renormalize weights across observed components and expose coverageWeight; never impute a missing external ranking as worst rank
